# Airline Pilot Central

> Comprehensive resource for commercial airline pilot careers, featuring detailed profiles of major U.S. carriers with pay scales, hiring requirements, fleet information, and domicile locations.

Airline Pilot Central aggregates critical career information for aspiring and current airline pilots, covering legacy carriers like United and Alaska Airlines alongside regional operators like SkyWest. The site provides detailed intelligence on pilot compensation, training facilities, aircraft types, and operational bases across the U.S. aviation network.

## Key Topics

- United Airlines
- SkyWest Airlines
- Alaska Airlines
- Pilot Hiring
- Pilot Pay Scales
- Fleet Information
- Domicile Locations
- First Officer Requirements
- Contract Agreements
- Training Facilities
- Aircraft Orders
- Regional Airlines
- ALPA (Airline Pilots Association)
- Airline Operations
- Career Progression

## Major Carriers

- [United Airlines](https://www.airlinepilotcentral.com/airlines/legacy/united_airlines): United Airlines pilot pay, hiring, fleet, contract (UPA23), and training facility details.
- [Alaska Airlines](https://www.airlinepilotcentral.com/airlines/legacy/alaska_airlines): Alaska Airlines pilot pay, hiring, benefits, fleet, domiciles, and Hawaiian acquisition info.

## Regional Airlines

- [SkyWest Airlines](https://www.airlinepilotcentral.com/airlines/regional/skywest): SkyWest Airlines pilot pay, hiring, benefits, fleet info, and domicile locations.
